annotations.title: RWA asset evidence (paid, x402; preview free)

csoai.deliverable: one card-v0 leaf, surface public.notice, kind csoai.eater.xrpl-issuer/0.1

description: PAID (x402). Per-request signed evidence card of ONE XRPL issued asset's deterministic on-ledger state via https://councilof.ai/api/rwa/evidence: AccountRoot lsf* flags, Domain, the two-way xrp-ledger.toml check (PASS / FAIL / UNCHECKABLE — unreachable is never FAIL), gateway_balances obligation, holders as the free reader has them, every raw fetch sha256'd. preview=true is free (unsigned state). Historical state at fetched_at — not a rating, not a guarantee, not a conformity mark; /api/xrpl and /root.json stay free. Without x_payment the tool returns the 402 challenge. If the route is not deployed on this origin the tool says NOT_DEPLOYED.

asset.description: Symbol (as listed by https://councilof.ai/api/xrpl) or issuer r-address.

purchase_action.description: Selfserve account-owned purchase action. Use Council bearer transport, omit x_payment; no new financial/provider action.

purchase_cursor.description: Owner-scoped history/decision page cursor; do not combine with exact decision id.

purchase_request_id.description: Idempotency id for the same exact decision intent, or exact id lookup when reading decisions. Never change inputs on an unknown write.

x_payment.description: The X-PAYMENT header value signed against accepts[] from the previous 402. Omit to receive the challenge.

name: rwa_evidence
